items.description: Re-signed DL Phidarian Mathis to the practice squad.
Placed S Jalen Thompson and DT Jonathan Bullard on injured reserve.
Signed LB Amen Ogbongbemiga from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Lawrence Keys to the practice squad.
Signed RB Owen Wright to the practice squad.
Re-signed DL Keith Cooper Jr. to the practice squad.
Signed P Johnny Hekker, RB Audric Estime, RB Devin Neal, OLB Keshawn Banks and G Josh Priebe to the practice squad.
Signed LB Jimmy Ciarlo to the practice squad.
Placed WR Jalen McMillan on injured reserve.
Placed CB Jaycee Horn and CB Michael Jackson on injured reserve.
Signed S K'Von Wallace from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Andre James and G Kyle Hergel to the practice squad.
Placed DL Mario Edwards on injured reserve.

Signed TE Tanner Hudson from the practice squad and WR Mitchell Tinsley from Houston's practice squad to the active roster. Placed CB Jalen Davis on injured reserve. Waived WR Ke'Shawn Williams. Signed S Isaiah Nwokobia and S Beau Brade to the practice squad.
Signed CB Myles Bryant and TE John FitzPatrick to the practice squad. Released CB D'Angelo Ross and TE Messiah Swinson from the practice squad. Released G Kendrick Green from injured reserve.
Released RB Damon Bankston and G Cordell Volson from the practice squad.

Signed G Garrett Dellinger and RB Michael Carter from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed G Fernando Carmona and G Jackson Slater on injured reserve. Signed OL Nick Broeker, DB Jakob Robinson and LB Owen Pappoe to the practice squad.
Signed CB Elijah Culp to the practice squad.
Placed WR Jack Bech on injured reserve. Signed WR Cody White. Waived WR Justin Shorter. Signed WR Phillip Dorsett to the practice squad.
Waived S Tanner Ingle.
Signed LB Shaka Heyward from Cincinnati's practice squad to the active roster. Signed G James Ester to the practice squad.

Signed QB Max Brosmer and LB Kyle Van Noy from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed TE Josh Oliver on injured reserve. Released P Johnny Hekker. Signed LB Kenny Dyson to the practice squad. Released RB Jerome Ford, DE Jonathan Harris and RB Jaret Patterson from the practice squad.
Placed OL Greg Van Roten on injured reserve. Released LB Riley Wilson from the practice squad.
Placed OLB Brian Burns on injured reserve.
Signed K Jason Sanders from the practice squad to the active roster. Waived K Blake Grupe and CB Jordan Clark. Signed OL Nick Dawkins and OL Jimmy Morrissey to the practice squad.
Signed RB Austin Ekeler to the active roster. Placed LB Leo Chenal on injured reserve and LB Marvin Jones on the practice squad/injured list. Signed OLB Charles Snowden to the practice squad.
Signed G Torricelli Simpkins III from the practice squad to the active roster. Waived LB Maema Njongmeta.
